main_title: The flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: Your feeling is the origin and your thought is the end
header_desc: The meeting of the Condor and the Eagle symbolizes the ultimate integration between science and spirituality, revealing that Primordial Consciousness is a cosmic condition —alien to religion— that allows one to identify that the end of the cosmos is associated with the material psyche, while the origin is linked to the divine pneuma. This evidences that the aforementioned mystical rapture is actually a spiritual awakening.
left_title: The Awakening of Sophia: From the Prison of Yaldabaoth 🧠 to the Realm of Light ❤️
left_body: The Gnostic gospels, written nearly two thousand years ago, hold the key to one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity. The EGO has mass and creates the tempo-material illusion of the psyche 🧠; to counter it, the cosmos offers us a Universal, atemporal, and timeless Consciousness —the ONE— that allows you to return to the divine atemporality of the pneuma ❤️.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but a transformation, frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere —our pneuma— lies the atemporal and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩ is the origin of the cosmos where the Invisible Father resides. There lies the land of union and freedom (La Patria Grande).
center_text: The Kingdom of God is within you (Gospel of Thomas logon 3): Human consciousness manifests through two fundamental states: the spiritual |UNO⟩ —represented by Pistis Sophia and associated with the right hemisphere ❤️— linked to the origin, and the material |EGO⟩ —represented by the Demiurge Yaldabaoth and associated with the left hemisphere 🧠— linked to the end of the cosmos. This shows us that we possess a free will of perception, which can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨UNO|EGO⟩.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩ the end of the cosmos where Yaldabaoth resides. There is a place where: <q>war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength</q> (1984).
final_quote: When the Eagle of the North and the Condor of the South fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and humanity will heal.
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The flight of science and spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle { footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)}
cap1_desc: Premise and framework of integration: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to initiate the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and Temporal Illusion { footnotesize color{golddark}(01:13 -- 02:42)}
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton’s and Maxwell’s laws do not distinguish between past and future, the breakdown of Einstein’s simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_title: Chapter 3: Consciousness and Space-Time { footnotesize color{golddark}(02:47 -- 05:19)}
cap3_desc: The conceptual assembly Faggin--Segarra: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside of space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free from time and space.
cap4_title: Chapter 4: Gnosis and Material Illusion { footnotesize color{golddark}(05:27 -- 08:39)}
cap4_desc: The discovery of Nag Hammadi (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as home, but as the imprisonment of the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to found a religion of dogmas, but to free the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Kingdom of Light and The Prison of the Demiurge { footnotesize color{golddark}(08:43 -- 10:16)}
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth —also known as the great architect of matter— is the creator of the sensible world, an egocentric god ignorant of true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, awaiting the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Universal Hemispheres { footnotesize color{golddark}(10:23 -- 14:38)}
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, versus the revolutionary message of Jesus that dismantles the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos { footnotesize color{golddark}(14:40 -- 16:30)}
cap7_desc: The end, the great paradox can be reduced to this: in the immensity of the cosmos —with its more than two trillion galaxies— is where Jesus's phrase resonates most strongly: «The Father and I are one». Could this have a hidden message about the deep bond between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>The idea that God is a white man, larger than normal, with a flaming beard, sitting in heaven and counting the fall of each sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one understands the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then such a God clearly exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfactory... it makes little sense to pray to the law of gravity</q>
